node_definition.done_when: Read section 38 of crew-runtime-positive-controls and its comment c-crpc-s34-relanded first; section 34 re-landed at ba52ed016, and an earlier attempt at this section conflicted with it and was discarded. At main, recovery.classify_pointer selects a run's stored review through _review_head_and_tree and recovery.newest_review_for_headless_run. Make the two other readers use that same selection, so they always agree with the classifier. One is the sub-floor dimension duty in reckon/crew/obligations.py (_sub_floor_items_by_session, which today passes reclaimed=False to newest_review_for_headless_run). The other is the disposition command in reckon/cli.py, which today calls recovery._reviewed_run_head directly. Touch only the disposition command in cli.py; cli.py is shared with a concurrent peer node. tests/test_one_review_head_resolver.py, in a temporary git repository and RECKON_HOME, drives each reader on two runs: a reclaimed run whose manifest names its head by a nine-character id, and a reclaimed run whose record names no head. It asserts each reader selects the same record the classifier selects. tests/test_reclaimed_run_review_head.py, tests/test_crew_scoring_state.py, tests/test_live_process_outranks_classification.py, tests/test_pointer_classification_is_memoised.py, tests/test_sub_floor_dimension_is_an_obligation.py and tests/test_sub_floor_disposition_has_a_writer.py keep passing. Record the outcome in docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/one-review-head-resolver.html. Run `date -u` first and treat that instant as your start; your deadline is 60 minutes later. Write your manifest before starting any long command. Run both gate arms with pytest-xdist (-n 8 --timeout=300), never serially. Run the base arm, from a `git archive` extraction of your base under /tmp in a directory named for this run, and then the head arm, each in the foreground: a background command dies when your turn ends. Keep the gate to the test files that reach your change, tens of files rather than hundreds. Each arm uses its own basetemp outside any repository and writes to its own new log path, which it never overwrites. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder. Each log names its revision on the first line as revision= followed by the full sha, and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed Python paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
